summary.text: Brent Money is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 2 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Brent Money was born in Greenville, Texas.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University-Commerce in 2001 and a law degree from Southern Methodist University in 2006.
In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2023, he said he is a sixth-generation Greenville resident, owns Money Law & Title, and has served on the Greenville City Council.
Money succeeded Jill Dutton in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
In that survey, he named border security, property taxes, life, guns, and education, including universal parental choice, as the policy areas he is passionate about.
